# madmom Windows runtime

`madmom-0.17.dev0-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl` was compiled from the official
CPJKU/madmom repository at commit `27f032e8947204902c675e5e341a3faf5dc86dae`.
It targets CPython 3.12, Windows x64, and NumPy 2. The wheel allows installation
of DBN postprocessing without requiring a C compiler on the user's computer.

Upstream source and license: https://github.com/CPJKU/madmom/tree/27f032e8947204902c675e5e341a3faf5dc86dae
The source is BSD licensed. Pretrained madmom model data uses a separate license;
the DBN in this application uses the Beat This activations rather than madmom's
pretrained neural models.
